markdown.headingText: Teaching as mentorship, communication, and growth
markdown.markdown:
::: {.teaching-hero}


I approach teaching as a **collaborative and student-centered process**. My goal is to help students build confidence, communicate ideas clearly, and connect analytical tools to **real societal challenges**.

:::

::: {.teaching-quotes}

::: {.teaching-quote}
“I never thought doing research could be so fun. That was because of you.”
:::

::: {.teaching-quote .teaching-quote-short}
“You’re the best TA I’ve ever met.”
:::

::: {.teaching-quote}
“I really hope I can keep working with Jingya. She’s always been incredibly helpful, warm, and considerate.”
:::


::: {.teaching-section}

### Mentoring

::: {.teaching-card}

#### CHEER Hub Summer Scholars Program  
*Summer 2026, 2025*

Mentored a cohort of **7 Summer Scholars**, including **4 undergraduate** and **3 graduate** students, in disaster risk and resilience research.

- Guided students in preparing and delivering final research presentations  
- Provided feedback on research framing, clarity, and communication  
- Supported technical and non-technical research storytelling  

:::

::: {.teaching-card}

#### Purdue Honors College Research Mentorship Program  
*Fall 2022*

Mentored undergraduate research on **equitable flood risk mitigation for coastal Louisiana**.

- Completed formal training in mentoring theory and practice  
- Guided project design using demographic and risk analysis  
- Helped develop a customized career development plan aligned with student goals  

:::

::: {.teaching-card}

#### Graduate and Thesis Mentorship  
*Purdue University, 2021–2023*

Mentored graduate research on **robust decision-making for coastal infrastructure**.

- Advised research on many-objective decision analysis for seawall upgrades  
- Supported research design, modeling approach, and interpretation  

:::

::: {.teaching-section}

### Classroom Teaching

::: {.teaching-card}

#### Teaching Assistant Experience  
*Edwardson School of Industrial Engineering, Purdue University*

I served as a teaching assistant for **two years** across core engineering courses in economics, probability, and statistics.

**Engineering Economics (IE 343)**  
Fall 2018, Spring 2019, Fall 2019, Spring 2020  

**Probability and Statistics in Engineering (IE 230)**  
Spring 2019  


:::

::: {.teaching-card}

#### Teaching Training and Communication  
*College of Liberal Arts, Purdue University*

Completed **Classroom Communication for International Graduate Students**, with training in classroom communication, active learning, inclusive engagement, and strategies for explaining complex ideas across diverse audiences.

:::


::: {.teaching-section}

### Academic Service & Leadership

::: {.teaching-card}

#### Professional Leadership

- **Chair**, Engineering & Infrastructure Specialty Group, Society for Risk Analysis (2023–2024)  
- **Vice Chair**, Engineering & Infrastructure Specialty Group, Society for Risk Analysis (2022–2023)

Led coordination of symposia, panels, and annual meeting activities, and supported community-building across academia, industry, and policy.

:::

::: {.teaching-card}

#### Community & Conference Service

- Postdoctoral Member, NSF Cross CoPe Student and Postdoc Planning Committee (2024–Present)  
- Poster Judge, Purdue Undergraduate Research Conference (2022)  
- Symposium Judge, Purdue SURF Program (2019)

:::

::: {.teaching-card}

#### Peer Review & Professional Membership

- **Trusted Reviewer**, IOP Publishing  
- Reviewer for journals including *Nature Communications Earth & Environment*, *Environmental Research Letters*, and *Natural Hazards Research*  
- Member, Society for Risk Analysis (SRA)  
- Member, INFORMS  

:::

:::
